prompt:
Vertical portrait food-marketing poster (9:16 social media story format) for frozen roti maryam / roti canai.

SCENE: Warm morning breakfast table shot from a 45-degree angle. A stack of 3 freshly pan-fried roti maryam, golden brown, flaky crispy layers, slightly torn on top showing soft airy inner layers, glistening with melted butter. Served on a rustic matte-white ceramic plate. Beside it: a small bowl of thick curry dipping sauce, a glass cup of hot teh susu with visible steam, and a scatter of sugar granules. Soft natural morning sunlight streaming from the left through a window, casting warm golden light and soft shadows. Wooden table surface, linen cloth in warm cream color. Background softly blurred (shallow depth of field), cozy home kitchen, warm bokeh.

STYLE: Professional food photography, high resolution, appetizing, warm golden-hour color grade, crisp texture detail on the flaky pastry layers, steam wisps visible. Clean and premium, not cluttered.

TEXT OVERLAY (must be spelled exactly, clean modern sans-serif, Indonesian language):
- Top area, large bold white headline with soft shadow: "ROTI MARYAM"
- Directly below in smaller warm-cream italic script: "Sarapan Hangat, Pagi Penuh Berkah"
- Bottom area, inside a rounded warm-orange banner, bold white text: "Tinggal Goreng, 3 Menit Siap"
- Very bottom, small clean white text: "TASAJI FOOD"

Keep all text perfectly legible, correctly spelled, well spaced, no extra random letters or gibberish. Leave the center of the frame clear so the food is the hero.
